name: Twilight Battle Orders
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Our scouts have reported new battle orders being issued by the Twilight's Hammer leaders.  The orders are being distributed by Twilight Prophets under heavy escort.  Intercept the orders and bring them to Commander Mar'alith.
narrative.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent. It's important to stay ahead of the enemy's next move. This information will allow us to anticipate the Twilight's Hammer's attacks.

giverName: an item: Tactical Task Briefing X
startItemText: an item: Tactical Task Briefing X
